candidate: one warp per shot; independent checks/variables parallel; ascending serial within-node FP64 reductions; warp phase fences and uniform convergence ballot; exact integer output XOR
training_regime: surface7; gross code-capacity with degree-aware CSR nodes
correctness_gate: zero correction/hard-decision/convergence differences; no rate-only equivalence claim
precision: FP64; alpha .875; max iterations 64; no altered reductions or approximate acceptance
go_gate: at least 1.2x gain vs the faster reference in at least one supported held-out operating cell, all four paired block ratios >1; otherwise no-go and revert prototype
adoption_scope: explicit opt-in only; defaults unchanged; throughput and latency evaluated independently, preserve losing cells
timing: four mirrored three-arm blocks, rotate first arm; fixed observations retained; warm reused scratch; upload/kernel/download timed; CPU accuracy, packing, construction and warm allocation excluded
cases: surface7/surface11/gross; shots 1,128,4096; rates .001,.03; extra surface7/gross shots 33,4097 p=.03
tails: single-shot cells get 64 timed observations per invocation (8 invocations per arm); batched cells get 3
resources: existing 2 GiB scratch budget; no forced OOM; services/clocks unchanged
negative_verdict: allowed if synchronization costs prevent useful operating cell; no unconditional GPU speedup promise
oracle_cache: One CPU mask vector/config/count receipt per exact DEM SHA256 + packed-input SHA256 + shots/seed/parameters; first GPU output must match CPU before cache creation; each use validates IDs and every correction; final untimed GPU warmup after CPU validation.
supplementary_trace: Added after primary campaign to distinguish varied-input latency from repeated-input jitter: 64 fixed physical-noise inputs per model/rate, eight replays per arm; never changes go gate.
